scope: Daily screening of all registered active editorial lines using 28 Oct FOMC, BoC, RBNZ, ABS, US Treasury, ICI and EIA observations, 29 Oct ABS Energy Account and WHO respiratory surveillance. Bounded review, not an assertion that no global event exists outside checked evidence.

selection_reason: No separate article: the most material current policy and cross-asset delta is in MT-GM-2026-10-29; Australia's newly released 2024–25 energy structure is recorded as an Atlas discovery candidate, not treated as an immediately operational 2026 change.
